note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = dial centre (hands on it). Plan sizes from the trace of the straightened 3/4 front photo (38 mm case, owner's spec sheet); heights are the house SNK623K1 values (no orthographic side view). All steel: polished case, crown and hands, brushed lugs, end link and bracelet with polished bevels; applied batons with a lume insert. SEIKO, the 5 shield, the printed lume 12 9 6, the print, the minute track and the day-date window stay in the dial map.

case.note: bezel from the photo: grey inner slope 15.4-16.8 mm, wide polished band sloping to the 19 mm edge

dial.note: navy dial to 13.78 mm, then the grey rehaut slope (both from the photo map)

bracelet.columns_note: [x0, x1 as a fraction of the half width, material]: end link across all three columns from under the case to the lug tips; outer links from the lug tips, centre links half a row later (first centre joint from the trace)
bracelet.bend_note: Smooth curl (house, from SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, end_y = tip + 2.2 R, links bend with the curve
bracelet.pitch_note: photo: 6.4-6.8 mm centre and 7.5-8.1 mm outer on the first rows (they lean away from the camera); 7.0 used for both

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

lume.note: light grey lume on the batons, hands and seconds disc as photographed

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL downscaled to 1K (keeps the GLB under 10 MB); lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material
